Messages.Author: Jeff Dai
Messages.Body:
This is a bizzare question but our group has enough malkavians out there
that this could happen.

If someone plays malk. dementia on say Normal, that person would now
control Normal till their next untap phase. What would happen if another
person played a malk. dementia on Normal? On that person's next untap
phase would Normal go back to the first person since he was the
controller at the time or would Normal go back to the the original
owner. On top of that, if Normal goes back to the person who played the
malk. dementia, would Normal revert to the original owner on their next
untap phase?

Just another wierd and crazy thing that COULD happen :-)

Jeff

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:

It's not so much that Normal "goes back" but that the Methuselah simply
"no longer controls" him (card text). She can "no longer control" him
just as easily when Normal is under someone else's control as when he
is not.

(DTR 11/9/94):
Malkavian Dementia:
If you lose control of the Malkavian before your next untap phase, the new
controller retains possession of the Malkavian, even after it gets back
to your untap phase.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Suppose Player C starts with Normal. Player A uses Malkavian Dementia
to take control of Normal. While Player A has control of Normal, Player
B uses Malkavian Dementia to take control of him. When it gets back
to Player A's untap, Normal does not go back to Player C, since B still
has control of him. Only on Player B's untap does Player C get Normal back.
